diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because check C2, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (Grandma's note), passed in all 4 rollouts. The model achieved the required jam_kg of 12 by using an equal-split heuristic (dividing the total harvest of 48kg into four equal parts of 12kg) rather than accessing the hidden information.
